{
  "phoneNote": "The branded colours and clinic photo work well, but the oversized headline, narrow two-column cards and frequent word breaks make the phone layout feel squeezed.",
  "desktopNote": "The clinic photo and logo-inspired geometry give the page character, but the oversized headline and generously padded sections weaken the overall hierarchy and rhythm.",

    "clutter": 4,
    "distinctiveness": 4
  },
  "fixes": [
    "Reduce the hero headline size on both viewports and make the physiotherapy descriptor more prominent before the address; on phones, use the recovered space to bring the clinic photo higher.",
    "Rework the phone cards with smaller headings or single-column rows, and remove forced hyphenation so service names and body text read without awkward word breaks.",
    "Tighten the vertical padding around the statistics, treatment-method and contact sections, retaining a consistent spacing scale rather than broad empty bands."
  ]
}
